_readme: Per-item mask rules for gen_masks.py. Piece numbers come from a --parts sheet (0 = most triangles). skin: piece list or 'all'; stock: pieces always stock; grip_end: low/high end of the long axis is the handle; grip: fraction of length cut from that end; band: [from, to] keep only that stretch. Decisions AJ 2026-11-07.

ulmMeleeBladeMisshapedJunkBlade._why: blade plates; pipe handle and bindings stock

ulmMeleeBladeRex._why: everything past the guard, teeth included

ulmMeleeBladeSaw._why: everything past the guard, teeth included

meleeWpnBladeT1CandyKnife._why: single piece; cane hook is the handle

ulmMeleeTwoHandedPipe._why: pipe + elbow; end cap and grip stock

ulmMeleeClubRollingPin._why: single piece: barrel only, both handles stock

ulmMeleeClubIron._why: the head cluster at the top; long handle stock

ulmMeleeClubTableLegMace._why: table leg; nails and bindings stock

meleeWpnClubT3SteelClub._why: shaft + head fins; hand guard and grip stock

meleeWpnClubT1CandyClub._why: AJ: held by the straight end; hook is the striking end

meleeWpnKnucklesT0LeatherKnuckles._why: leather wraps; buckle and studs stock

ulmMeleeKnucklesJunkKnuckles._why: body plate (piece 7); bindings, handle, blades, nails stock

meleeToolSalvageT2Ratchet._why: AJ: ratchet head only; handle and socket stock

meleeToolSalvageT3ImpactDriver._why: AJ: nose + motor housing; battery and bit stock

ulmMeleeAxeScrapIron._why: axe head; shaft, wire, bindings stock

ulmMeleeAxeCrudeIron._why: crescent head; shaft and loop stock
